answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 151397 Country: India Title: Property inheritance Question: We are 2 brothers and one sister who is no more. My father is alive but my mother is dead. My dead sister has left behind 1 son and 1 daughter, besides her husband. Are my sister's children entitled to inherit our ancestral property? If yes, in what proportion? Answer ID: 151397 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 894/831/SD=9/1438) If your father is alive then he alone is the owner of all his property. There is no share of any of his heir in his property before his death. He has full right in his property to use it as he wishes. During his lifetime if he wants to give something to his Nawasa and Nawasi (grandchildren) then he may give to them. Yes, after his death in the presence of his children, the Nawasa and Nawasi will get nothing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
